meta.description: Plarail Meme Real-2-Sim — browser track builder and train physics (MIT).

app.title: Plarail Meme - Real-2-Sim
app.blurb:
Unit = R-01 = R-03 radius.
Left-drag place · Right-click train/rotate.

ui.flipTitle: Flip: piece gender M↔F, or train direction when train selected (F)
ui.mirrorTitle: Mirror L/R or A/B (M) — curve bend / turnout side
ui.solidWallsTitle: Playfield walls: bounce at the edge (off = stop at edge)
ui.solidWallsOn: Playfield walls ON — bounce at the wood edge (click to turn off)
ui.solidWallsOff: Playfield walls OFF — train stops at the red dashed edge (click to enable bounce)
ui.paintTitle: Click a color, then click a piece to paint once

help.drag: Left-drag from palette — magnetic snap joins open ends (no auto-rotate / auto-flip). Rotate with ↻ / R first if needed.
help.rightClick: Right-click piece — rotate 45° · lever — switch · empty + palette — stamp. (Train is not placed with right-click.)
help.toolbar: Bottom bar: ↻ rotate · 🦄 gender / train flip · ⇋ mirror · 🗑 delete · ✕ clear. Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+A select all.
help.train: 🚂 Train — drag from palette onto a rail (like a piece). Click train to select · drag to re-seat · 🦄 / F reverses direction · Start / Space runs.
help.boxSelect: Box-select: drag empty floor to multi-select, then drag any selected piece to move the group. Shift-click to add/remove.
help.save: Save JSON downloads a file and autosaves to the browser (restored on reload). Never loses the layout to a stuck save dialog.
help.paint: Paint (toolbar swatches): click Blue / Green / Red / Gray, then click a piece once — color applies and the cursor returns to normal.
help.view: View: scroll / pinch to zoom · drag empty floor to pan · Fit track frames the whole layout. Sidebar collapses on narrow screens (› reopens it).
help.walls: 🧱 Walls: solid wood playfield border — train bounces at the edge instead of stopping. Toggle on the bottom toolbar.
help.tracks: Tracks: pick a built-in layout in the sidebar dropdown, then Load.
help.sound: Sound is pure Web Audio (no libraries): plastic gear mesh (bandpass noise × square AM). Same motor on-rail and off-rail (quieter off-rail; tooth rate follows speed). Unlocks after first click.
help.units: 1 unit = R-01 length = R-03 radius (sim UNIT px). R-20 = ¼ · R-02 = ½ · R-07 = 2 · R-21 / R-10.5 = 90° at r=1 · R-04 large r≈1.4 · R-13 double-track gap ≈ 0.32 unit. Catalog extras: R-10 U-turn, R-22 Y, R-23 wavy.

badge.offRails: Mode: Off rails — sliding on floor / edges
badge.stopped: Mode: Stopped — hit canvas edge · reset train

note.real-meme: Loaded Real-2-Sim meme track ({count} pieces). Drag train onto a rail, then Start.
note.arntenoughrails: Loaded “aren't enough rails” ({count} pieces, 3 separate cars coupled, solid walls). Mid in palette · 🦄 switches engine · Delete removes car.

track.noRail: Track loaded but no rail found for the train — drag Engine onto a path.
track.restoredAutosave: Restored autosaved layout. 🚂 train · box-select multi-move · Save downloads JSON. Scroll to zoom.
track.defaultMeme: Real-2-Sim meme track loaded. 🚂 drag train · box-select · Save JSON downloads + autosaves.

palette.activeEngineDesc: Drag onto rail · red roof dot · one powered
palette.activeEngineOn: Active engine: drag onto rail. Coupling it makes this the one powered end.
palette.passiveEngineDesc: Drag onto rail · couple as unpowered end
palette.passiveEngineOn: Passive engine: drag onto rail near the active chain tail to couple.
palette.midDesc: Drag onto a rail · couple behind engine
palette.midOn: Mid car tool: left-drag onto a rail. Select + Delete uncouples.
palette.pieceSelected: Selected: {code} {name}. Left-drag to place · 🦄 gender · ⇋ L/R · box-drag empty to multi-select.

confirm.clearBoard: Clear the entire track board? This cannot be undone (autosave will also be cleared).

paint.armed: Paint: {color}. Click a track piece once to color it.
paint.cancelledClick: Paint cancelled (click a track piece while paint is armed).

hint.powerSwitched: Powered engine switched. Green ring = active. Only one engine drives.
hint.trainForward: Train facing forward. Start to run that way.
hint.trainReverse: Train facing reverse. Start to run that way.
hint.trainDeleted: Train deleted. Drag 🚂 engine onto a rail, then add mid cars (max 3).
hint.carDeleted: Car deleted. Add units from palette (engine / mid) · max 3 mids.
hint.trainCleared: Train cleared. Place engine alone, then build mid cars.
hint.wallsOn: 🧱 Playfield walls on — wood border, train bounces at the edge.
hint.wallsOff: Playfield walls off — train stops if it leaves the dashed edge.
hint.fittedPan: Fitted track to view. Scroll / pinch to zoom · drag floor to pan.
hint.dragTrainStart: Drag 🚂 train from the palette onto a rail, then Start.
hint.hitEdge: Train hit the edge. Reset Train, place on rail, then Start.
hint.notOnRail: Train is not on a rail — drag 🚂 onto a blue path.
hint.running: Running. Follows connected track · open ends derail · walls glide.
hint.couldNotStart: Could not start — seat the train on an active rail path first.
hint.resetTrain: Train cleared. Drag 🚂 engine alone onto a rail, then mid cars (max 3).
hint.genderFlipped: Gender flipped (F↔M). Use ⇋ / M for L/R bend.
hint.genderDefault: Gender default (M→F). Use ⇋ / M for L/R bend.
hint.carSelected: Car selected ({id}). 🦄 = active engine ({powered}). Delete removes car · drag to re-seat.
hint.rightClickHelp: Right-click piece → rotate · lever → switch · empty+palette → stamp. Place train with 🚂.
hint.midRejected: Mid placement rejected: it would overlap rolling stock or stretch a coupler.
hint.midFree: Mid on rails ({count}/{max}). Drop near coupler to link · Delete removes.
hint.engineOnRails: Engine on rails. Start runs · 🦄 flips direction or switches power.
hint.passiveParked: Passive engine parked. Add an active engine to power a chain.
hint.engineRejected: Engine placement rejected: crowded track would overlap another car.
hint.activeCoupled: Active engine coupled; red dot marks the powered end.
hint.activeParkedPrev: Active engine placed; previous stock is now parked/uncoupled.
hint.activeFail: Could not make the dropped engine active.
hint.passiveCoupled: Passive engine coupled. Select it + 🦄 to switch power.
hint.passiveFree: Passive engine on rails (free). Drop near a coupler to link.
hint.engineAlone: Engine on rails (alone). Add mid cars from palette (max 3), then optional trail engine.
hint.dropOnRail: Drop on a blue rail centerline (green ring = snapped).
hint.boxSelected: Selected {count} piece(s). Drag any to move all · Del deletes.
hint.movedSnapped: Moved {count} pieces (snapped free end to open rail).
hint.piecePlaced: Piece placed. Drag near open ends to snap · 🚂 for train.
hint.pieceSelected: Selected. Drag to move · box-drag empty for multi-select.
hint.stoppedSolid: Train stopped. Reset Train, place on rail, then Start.
hint.stoppedEdge: Train left the playfield. Reset Train, place on rail, then Start. (Or turn on 🧱 walls to bounce.)
